about_the_game:
BEND THE ELEMENTS

Make the elemental resources bend to your will. Transform the flames of a forest into a blazing fireball, or cause lakes to vanish, rising mist that cloaks the world in shadow. Strategize ahead, shaping the environment to your advantage, and combine resources to cast devastating spells.

COLLECT SPELL CARDS

Choose wisely from the cards that come your way. Discover endless combinations and utilities for each spell card.

REACT TO YOUR FOES

Be aware of your surroundings, for the world is full of both danger and opportunity. Turn-based combat gives you the chance to react to opponents’ spells or plan ahead, layering spells for unique effects.

THE WORLD OF UROK

An ancient hex has fallen upon your homeland, sending the natural elements into chaos. Along the way, you will encounter figures lost to time—some may offer aid, others may stand in your way. Choose wisely, for the fate of the world lies in your hands.

KEY FEATURES

  • Use hexagonal tiles with elemental resources (fire, water, wood, stone, and air) to cast powerful spells.

  • Shape the environment to your advantage by manipulating the natural elements.

  • Cast devastating spells to overcome foul creatures and obstacles in your path.

  • Plan your moves in strategic turn-based combat to outwit enemies.

  • Discover new spell cards for endless strategic possibilities.

  • Explore a cursed land and encounter mysterious figures on your journey.
